title: Tasting Tuesday: Prohibition Era Dinner
seo_title: Tasting Tuesday: Prohibition Era Dinner at The Garrison
description: Tasting Tuesday: Prohibition Era Dinner is a six-course dinner at The Garrison where the Lead Mixologist leads guests through classic gin and whiskey cocktails paired with each course. It is for guests ages 21+, and mocktails are available if requested in your reservation notes or by emailing happenings@finleyfarmsmo.com in advance. It takes place Tuesday, January 12, 2027, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at The Garrison.
